findings.title: Nextcloud Docker container is running but failing its health check
findings.conclusion:
### Investigation Summary
The nextcloud app container (app-container-e87583fa0bec4317) on docker01 is running with near-zero CPU/memory but failing its Docker health check, matching the critical alert. Docker logs (last 30m) show repeated Apache/PHP errors: `Doctrine\DBAL\Exception: SQLSTATE[08006] connection to server at "nextcloud-db", port 5432 failed: Connection refused`. A fleet inventory check of docker01's app containers confirmed `nextcloud-db` (postgres:16, app-container-3a02b070bacf2aac) is in status=exited. Nextcloud is up and accepting the health probe, but the probe fails because the application cannot reach its Postgres database, which is not running — fully explaining both the unhealthy status and the idle CPU/memory profile (the app is blocked on a failed DB connection, not under load or hung on its own).

### Root Cause
Causal resource: nextcloud-db (app-container-3a02b070bacf2aac) — the Postgres 16 container backing Nextcloud is stopped (status=exited) on docker01. This directly causes Nextcloud's healthcheck failures via repeated connection-refused errors to nextcloud-db:5432.
Not established by current evidence: why nextcloud-db exited — no postgres logs, exit code, or docker01 host-level events (e.g., OOM kill, manual stop, crash, disk issue, dependency/start-ordering problem) were inspected in this run. Also unverified: whether nextcloud-db restarts cleanly and stays up once started, and whether it had crashed before or was simply never brought back up after some host event.

### Affected Resources
- nextcloud (app-container-e87583fa0bec4317): observed symptom — Docker status "running", health "unhealthy", 0 restarts, repeated DB connection-refused errors in its logs. This is the symptom, not the cause.
- nextcloud-db (app-container-3a02b070bacf2aac): the causal resource, status "exited".
- vaultwarden-db-migrate (app-container-7d93fd2a83f63840) is also exited on docker01 but is a one-shot migration job and not implicated in this finding; noted only for completeness, not investigated further.

### Recommendation
A plan to start nextcloud-db (capability "start" on app-container-3a02b070bacf2aac) has been persisted (action_id act_cdcdc1d852fe8ddace6fe9362b4c903c, state pending_approval). An admin must approve this action before it executes. After approval and execution, verify nextcloud-db stays up (check logs/exit status) and confirm Nextcloud's health transitions to "healthy" and the critical alert clears. If nextcloud-db exits again after being started, escalate to inspect its own logs, docker01 disk/memory pressure, and any compose/orchestration dependency ordering that may have left it stopped. Separately, the nextcloud:30-apache image update can be evaluated once the current incident is resolved — not urgent.

### Conclusion
NEEDS_ATTENTION: An admin must approve the pending "start" action on nextcloud-db (app-container-3a02b070bacf2aac) to restore Nextcloud's database connectivity and clear the health check failure. After approval, verify nextcloud-db remains running (it may need log review if it exits again) and confirm Nextcloud's health status returns to healthy.
